Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
2104-7443.notes: If Emeritus of Abundance is prepared when starting the combo, you can forego attacking with it and skip straight to step 2 the first iteration. This also removes the necessity of Emeritus not have summoning sickness.
